verdict.rationale: Plugins run inside the built-in AI assistant in ChatGPT (Chat/Work) and Codex, and users hand it tasks through them: summarizing Slack channels or drafting replies, sending messages on their behalf, and running security scans. The assistant also chooses skills on its own, and community users describe telling it things like "use the PR skill to open a PR." Missing for 10: no hands-on runtime probe of a delegated task completing (the probes only cover catalog fetch and install), and no first-party documentation of the host assistant's agentic limits or approvals beyond plugin-level notes.
